sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000163-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 163 on November 14, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 75%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
